ctaHeading: Spotswood's carpentry team is ready to assist.
aboutText: Based in Spotswood, Carpentry and Furniture specialises in custom carpentry and handmade furniture. We have been serving the local community for years, providing high-quality solutions for homes and businesses. From bespoke joinery to complete furniture projects, our team ensures every detail is perfect. Contact us to discuss your next project in Spotswood.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of carpentry services, including custom furniture, joinery, and restoration. Each project is approached with meticulous attention to detail, using quality materials to ensure longevity and beauty.

services.title: Custom Carpentry
services.desc: Tailored carpentry projects designed and built to your specifications in Spotswood and beyond.

services.title: Handmade Furniture
services.desc: Unique, handcrafted furniture pieces made from sustainable timber, perfect for any space.

services.title: Joinery Services
services.desc: Expert joinery for doors, windows, and built-in storage, enhancing functionality and style.

services.title: Cabinet Making
services.desc: Custom cabinets and vanities for kitchens, bathrooms, and living areas, crafted with precision.

services.title: Furniture Restoration
services.desc: Revitalise your existing furniture with professional restoration, preserving its character and beauty.

services.title: Outdoor Carpentry
services.desc: Decks, pergolas, and outdoor structures to extend your living space in Spotswood's climate.
